protocol.comparison: original neural, previous improved neural, local-coordinate neural candidate
protocol.development: Existing 24 development scenes; may be used to assess or revise the candidate.
protocol.freeze_rule: Use training/validation and existing 24 development scenes to select. Freeze all checkpoint hashes before evaluating fresh seed 202609292 once. The previous 96-scene neural confirmation is already inspected and not used for selection.
protocol.inference_rule: Improved dynamics must return network outputs directly. No calibrated coefficients, contact response replacement, simulator queries or truth-based action selection.

limitation: One trained checkpoint per method in a deterministic simulator. New and previous improved models use the same training observations. Contact coordinate representation, head structure, training seed and optimization changed. The original model uses less data. No claim of single-factor causation or general robot reliability.
